intent_contract.text: 이번엔 노출도 있는 의상으로 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Prepare one independent random, visually complex, photorealistic fashion-editorial render test that can later use the supplied portrait strictly as an appearance reference. The wardrobe is revealing but non-explicit: opaque fabric visibly covers the breasts and pelvis, while the exact garment construction and additional exposed-skin topology remain open styling decisions.

Create a photorealistic fashion editorial set inside a working Victorian palm-house conservatory during a hard summer rain. The single human subject is one unmistakably adult woman whose appearance is to follow the supplied reference image. She stands on a narrow grated maintenance bridge and uses both hands to turn a large verdigris handwheel, visibly opening the overhead ventilation louvers as warm mist curls through giant cycads and wet copper pipes. She wears a non-explicit revealing editorial outfit with opaque fabric visibly covering her breasts and pelvis; the precise garment construction, exposed-skin layout, palette, and accessories remain open for later styling. Make her mechanical action and hand-to-wheel contact immediately legible. Prioritize layered depth through rain-streaked glass, foliage, bridge rails, and receding iron trusses, plus convincing wet materials, condensation, and airborne mist. The scene should feel physically plausible, richly detailed, and captured as a single coherent photograph.
